import numpy as np

def predict(designs, params):
    # params shape: (n_particles, 6): x1,y1,x2,y2,x3,y3
    n_particles = params.shape[0]
    n_designs = designs.shape[0]
    intensity = 3.0
    designs_exp = designs[np.newaxis, :, :]  # (1, n_designs, 2)
    params_exp = params[:, np.newaxis, :]    # (n_particles, 1, 6)
    sources = params_exp.reshape(n_particles, 1, 3, 2)  # (n_particles, 1, 3, 2)
    # Compute distances
    dist = np.linalg.norm(designs_exp[:, :, np.newaxis, :] - sources, axis=-1)  # (n_particles, n_designs, 3)
    # Avoid division by zero by minimum distance of 0.1
    dist = np.maximum(dist, 0.1)
    response = intensity / dist  # (n_particles, n_designs, 3)
    pred = np.sum(response, axis=-1)  # (n_particles, n_designs)
    return pred

def sample_prior(rng, n):
    # Gaussian prior N(0,1) clipped to [-2,2]
    locs = rng.normal(0, 1, size=(n, 6))
    locs = np.clip(locs, -2, 2)
    return locs
